groups.defect: AssignmentSource.queued defaults to timezone.now(), which runs once at import time, so every instance gets the same stale timestamp. Separately, to_dict() returns a raw datetime that Celery's JSON serialization of the apply_async kwargs in sync_group_assignee_outbound cannot handle. Fix: use field(default_factory=timezone.now), and write queued as an ISO string in to_dict() and parse it back in from_dict() (or leave queued out of the dict).
